run 11 — Part A1, PR #137. Owner's decision: a question that IS a
pointer — a bare scripture reference or a bare quotation — gets a NAMED
outcome rather than being counted as a failure. Exactly five angles
stays required for every real question, and the duplicate rule is not
loosened.

The test reads the QUESTION, never the plan, so a real question whose
angles come back repetitive is still a recorded failure. It classifies
exactly q001-q012 of the gold set and nothing else.
